# funzione h5ad to Seurat
```{r}
h5ad_to_seurat <- function(file_path) {
  
  # load h5ad
  ad <- read_h5ad(file_path)
  
  # expression matrix (AnnData: cells x genes → Seurat: genes x cells)
  expr <- t(ad$X)
  
  # Seurat object
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = expr,
    assay = "RNA"
  )
  
  # metto i dati nel layer data (caso default: dati già normalizzati)
  obj <- SetAssayData(
    obj,
    layer = "data",
    new.data = expr
  )
  
  # aggiungo metadata se presenti
  if (!is.null(ad$obs)) {
    obj <- AddMetaData(
      obj,
      metadata = ad$obs[colnames(obj), ]
    )
  }
  
  return(obj)
}
```

# Dataset Loading + Object Seurat Creation
```{r}

obj2 <- h5ad_to_seurat("/home/drighelli/lncRNA_project/DATAH/pdac_GSE154778.h5ad")
obj3 <- h5ad_to_seurat("/home/drighelli/lncRNA_project/DATAH/pdac_GSE155698.h5ad")

obj1$GSE <- "GSE141017"
obj2$GSE <- "GSE154778"
obj3$GSE <- "GSE155698"

obj1$Cell_type <- obj1$Celltype; obj1$Celltype <- NULL
obj2$Cell_type <- obj2$Celltype; obj2$Celltype <- NULL
obj3$Cell_type <- obj3$Celltype; obj3$Celltype <- NULL

obj <- merge(
  x = obj1,
  y = list(obj2, obj3),
  add.cell.ids = c("GSE141017", "GSE154778", "GSE155698")
)

fix_sparse <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "dgRMatrix")) {
    x <- as(x, "TsparseMatrix")
    x <- as(x, "CsparseMatrix")
  } else {
    x <- as(x, "CsparseMatrix")
  }
  return(x)
}

obj[["RNA"]]$counts.1 <- fix_sparse(obj[["RNA"]]$counts.1)
obj[["RNA"]]$counts.2 <- fix_sparse(obj[["RNA"]]$counts.2)
obj[["RNA"]]$counts.3 <- fix_sparse(obj[["RNA"]]$counts.3)

obj[["RNA"]]$data.1 <- fix_sparse(obj[["RNA"]]$data.1)
obj[["RNA"]]$data.2 <- fix_sparse(obj[["RNA"]]$data.2)
obj[["RNA"]]$data.3 <- fix_sparse(obj[["RNA"]]$data.3)

obj <- JoinLayers(obj)
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj)
obj
obj[["RNA"]]$counts <- NULL

# Salva l'rds di obj prima di effettuare la centratura dei dati così da decidere se è il caso o no di usare scale data
saveRDS(obj,  file = "/home/drighelli/lncRNA_project/OUT/PDAC/obj_merged.rds")

cols <- kelly()[1:length(unique(obj$GSE))]
cols2 <- kelly()[1:length(unique(obj$Cell_type))]

VlnPlot(obj, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"), group.by = "GSE", pt.size = 0, cols = cols)

obj <- readRDS("/home/drighelli/lncRNA_project/OUT/PDAC/obj_merged.rds")
```

# Run PCA
```{r}
obj <- RunPCA(
  obj,
  features = VariableFeatures(obj)
)

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "pca", group.by = "GSE")

emb <- Embeddings(obj, "pca")

harmony_emb <- RunHarmony(
  data_mat = emb,
  meta_data = obj@meta.data,
  vars_use = "GSE"
)

# aggiungi al Seurat object
obj[["harmony"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = harmony_emb,
  key = "HARMONY_",
  assay = DefaultAssay(obj)
)

obj <- RunUMAP(
  obj,
  reduction = "harmony",
  dims = 1:30
)

DimPlot(obj_umap, reduction = "umap", group.by = "GSE")
```

# Cell type specificity

We used gencode annotation to identify the lncRNAs and protein coding genes which are measured in the scRNA-seq data. We then compared the cell type specificity between protein coding and lncRNA genes estimating the Gini Coefficient.

```{r}
obj <- readRDS("/home/drighelli/lncRNA_project/OUT/PDAC/obj_merged.rds")

gencode <- read.table("/home/drighelli/lncRNA_project/DATA/gencode_v49.txt", header = TRUE)

lnc  <- gencode[gencode$type == "lncRNA", ]
prot <- gencode[gencode$type == "protein_coding", ]

genes_obj <- rownames(obj)

lnc_raw  <- intersect(genes_obj, lnc$SYMBOL)
prot_raw <- intersect(genes_obj, prot$SYMBOL)
```

# Gini Function
```{r}
compute_gini_dotplot <- function(features_chunk) {
  dp <- DotPlot(obj, features = features_chunk)
  df <- dp$data
  
  df <- df[, c("features.plot", "pct.exp")]
  
  out <- aggregate(pct.exp ~ features.plot, df, function(x) Gini(x))
  
  colnames(out) <- c("gene", "gini")
  return(out)
}

# Parameter
chunk_size <- 1000

```

# lncRNA Gini
```{r}
chunks_lnc <- split(lnc_features, ceiling(seq_along(lnc_features)/chunk_size))

Gini_list_lnc <- lapply(chunks_lnc, compute_gini_dotplot)

GiniCoef_lnc <- do.call(rbind, Gini_list_lnc)
GiniCoef_lnc$type <- "lncRNA"
```

# Protein coding Gini
```{r}
chunks_prot <- split(prot_features, ceiling(seq_along(prot_features)/chunk_size))

Gini_list_prot <- lapply(chunks_prot, compute_gini_dotplot)

GiniCoef_prot <- do.call(rbind, Gini_list_prot)
GiniCoef_prot$type <- "protein_coding"
```

# Merge Final Dataset
```{r}
GiniCoef <- rbind(GiniCoef_lnc, GiniCoef_prot)
colnames(GiniCoef)[1] <- "gene"

saveRDS(GiniCoef, "/home/drighelli/lncRNA_project/OUT/PDAC/gini_dotplot_v49.Rds")
```

```{r}
GiniCoef <- readRDS("/home/drighelli/lncRNA_project/OUT/PDAC/gini_dotplot_v49.Rds")
```

```{r}
ggplot(GiniCoef_clean, aes(x = type, y = gini, fill = type)) +

  stat_compare_means(hjust = 0) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = kelly()[c(12,9)]) +

      paste0("(n = ", prot_n, ")")
    ),
    col = "black",
    size = 4,
    geom = "text"
  )
```

# Epithelial lncRNAs
We performed differential expression to identify the lncRNAs which are significantly (adjusted pvalue < 0.01) enriched in the epithelial cells.

```{r}
Idents(obj) <- "Cell_type"

gencode <- read.table("/home/drighelli/lncRNA_project/DATA/gencode_v49.txt", header = TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Filtra solo lncRNA presenti nell'oggetto
lnc <- filter(gencode, type == "lncRNA")
lnc <- lnc[lnc$SYMBOL %in% rownames(obj), ]
lnc_genes <- unique(lnc$SYMBOL)

# DotPlot
lnc_percent <- DotPlot(obj, features = lnc_genes)$data

# FindMarkers per le cellule epiteliali
obj <- JoinLayers(obj)
Idents(obj) <- "Cell_type"

M <- FindMarkers(
  object = obj,
  ident.1 = "Epithelial",
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0,
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  features = lnc_genes
)
M <- subset(M, p_val_adj < 0.01)

# Filtra DotPlot per geni significativi
lnc_percent2 <- subset(lnc_percent, features.plot %in% rownames(M))
lnc_percent2$id <- factor(
  lnc_percent2$id,
  levels = c("B cells", "Epithelial cells", "Mast cells", "Myeloids", "Stromal cells", "T cells")
)

```
